facts.text: ISO/IEC/IEEE 29119-3:2021 defines test-documentation structures covering test plans, designs, cases and completion reports.
facts.quote: ISO/IEC/IEEE 29119-3:2021 defines test-documentation structures (test plan, design, case and completion reports)

facts.text: ISO/IEC/IEEE 29119-3:2021 and ISO/IEC/IEEE 29119-4:2021 address generic software and systems testing and contain no collision-avoidance content.
facts.quote: They are generic software and systems testing with no collision-avoidance content.

facts.text: ASAM MDF 4.3.0, dated September 2025, is a standardised binary format for measured and calculated signals, bus traffic and sensor data, including metadata and synchronisation.
facts.quote: ASAM MDF 4.3.0 (September 2025) is a standardised binary format for measured and calculated signals, bus traffic and sensor data, with metadata and synchronisation.

facts.text: ASAM MDF is one neutral format option; other structured or in-house formats satisfy the same architecture if provenance and long-term readability are controlled.
facts.quote: It is one neutral option; other structured or in-house formats satisfy the same architecture if provenance and long-term readability are controlled.

facts.text: ASAM ATX represents test projects, specifications, test-case metadata, parameter values, suites, reports and results.
facts.quote: ASAM ATX represents test projects, specifications, test-case metadata, parameter values, suites, reports and results.

facts.text: ASAM is developing a broader TestSpecification concept linking specification, implementation and execution.
facts.quote: ASAM is also developing a broader TestSpecification concept linking specification, implementation and execution

facts.text: As of October 2026, ASAM's TestSpecification concept is developing infrastructure, not a mature universal solution.
facts.quote: as of October 2026 it is developing infrastructure, not a mature universal solution.

facts.text: A neutral test-management implementation can be commercial, open-source or in-house.
facts.quote: A neutral implementation can be commercial, open-source or in-house

facts.text: A commercial ALM or requirements platform can manage requirements, hazards, approvals and traceability in a neutral test-management implementation.
facts.quote: a commercial ALM or requirements platform for requirements, hazards, approvals and traceability

facts.text: Open-source version control and CI, combined with a database and object store, can manage scenarios, configurations, automation and artefacts in a neutral test-management implementation.
facts.quote: open-source version control and CI plus a database and object store for scenarios, configurations, automation and artefacts

facts.text: An in-house campaign service can generate runs, schedule simulators, HIL and physical benches, and compute coverage and verdicts.
facts.quote: an in-house campaign service that generates runs, schedules simulators, HIL and physical benches, and computes coverage and verdicts.

facts.text: The important property of a neutral test-management implementation is a stable machine-readable data model with immutable IDs, rather than its brand.
facts.quote: The important property is a stable machine-readable data model with immutable IDs, not the brand.
